gaps.sentence: He did it ___ purpose, just to annoy her.
The smell was ___ this world — absolutely incredible.
The castle dates ___ to the fourteenth century.
The village is accessible only ___ foot.
gaps.explanation: 'on foot' = walking (never 'by foot' in careful usage).

gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: She learnt Russian ___ watching films alone.
The letter arrived ___ due course — three weeks later.
gaps.hint: ___ due course = at the expected time
gaps.explanation: 'in due course' = at the proper time eventually.

gaps.sentence: He completed the marathon despite being ___ breath.
gaps.explanation: 'out of breath' = breathing fast from effort.
